description:
Java port of ragleap-graph: knowledge-graph-augmented retrieval for RAG, talking to
        Neo4j over its HTTP Query API (no Neo4j driver dependency; tested only against
        Neo4j 5.26 Community, single server only). Included: regex entity extraction;
        optional LLM entity and relation extraction through a small LlmClient interface,
        with an optional adapter for ragleap-rag (not live-verified against real model
        providers, tested with scripted answers only); entity deduplication; document
        indexing (upsertDocument) with per-document weights, co-occurrence edges and typed
        relations; six lookups (documents by entities, related entities, typed relations,
        lineage, entities by type, document entities); GraphRetriever (hybrid vector plus
        graph retrieval, or graph only, with citations); and one-time backfills with a
        schema migration runner. A PostgreSQL audit writer (PostgresAuditSink, over a PostgreSQL JDBC driver you supply; tested against a real PostgreSQL on the maintainer's machine, not in CI) is included. Independently
        versioned from the Python package (see https://pypi.org/project/ragleap-graph/).
